subject: Renewal: Term architecture proposal & auto-renew safeguards
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@bluewaveanalytics.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Term architecture proposal & autorenew safeguards

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the honest conversation on Friday. Per our call, I pulled together a pragmatic term proposal that aligns BlueWave's product launch cadence with a predictable ramp while protecting you on auto-renew triggers. High level:

- Year structure: 18-month initial term (to align with your fiscal Q3 launch) then optional 12- or 24-month renewals.
- Ramp schedule: staged token buckets at months 1/6/12/18 with pre-agreed uplift windows (10% buffer on initial forecast).
- Auto-renew guardrail: auto-renew activates only if usage stays within a 20% variance band vs final month of the term AND both parties confirm 30 days before renewal; otherwise renewal reverts to month-to-month until we agree a new commitment.
- Co-terming: we can align to your fiscal year at the next renewal with a prorated true-up month to minimize billing shock.

I've attached an editable term_matrix_and_ramp.xlsx and a redline-friendly SOW (SOW_BlueWave_v2.pdf). If this looks reasonable, can we get procurement looped in next week to start the paperwork cadence?

Next steps I suggest:
1) Procurement contact + preferred contract owner at BlueWave (we need the legal POC).
2) Confirm whether you want the 12- or 24-month renewal option after the initial 18 months.
3) Decide on the 20% variance band or adjust to a tighter 10% band (your call based on budget tolerance).

Happy to run through the term matrix live — available Wed/Thu morning PT.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: SOW_BlueWave_v2.pdf (editable, redline-friendly)
Attachment: term_matrix_and_ramp.xlsx

From: Sara Patel <sara@bluewaveanalytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@bluewaveanalytics.com>, procurement@bluewaveanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 2 May 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Term architecture proposal & autorenew safeguards

Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear framing. A few quick notes from the product & finance side:

- The 18-month initial term sounds good to align with our launch; leaning toward the 12-month renewal option thereafter.
- The 20% variance band is reasonable, but procurement will push for an explicit cap on price increases at renewal.
- We need the ability to pause auto-renew if there's an active procurement review (30 days notice).

I copied Tom (Head of Product) and procurement so they can weigh in on the contract language. We can meet Friday 10am PT to go through the workbook.

—Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Data & AI | BlueWave Analytics
sara@bluewaveanalytics.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 May 2028 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Term architecture proposal & autorenew safeguards

Team —

Looping you all in after Sara's notes. Procurement will likely ask for a hard cap on year-over-year price movement; product wants the 12-month post-term option. Key asks for us to prepare:

- Sales ops: prepare a prorate formula for co-terming to BlueWave's FY (they close FY on Mar 31). Include example invoices showing month-of-proration.
- Legal (Marissa): draft language for the auto-renew pause (must allow procurement review to suspend auto-renew for up to 60 days with written notice).
- Camila (CS): confirm onboarding milestones we can tie to ramp buckets so we can justify the scheduled capacity increases.

We have a joint call Friday 10am PT with Sara/Tom — please bring the workbook and an example SOW with the 18m + optional 12m language.

Thanks,
Steph

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 May 2028 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Term architecture proposal & autorenew safeguards

All —

Thanks for the beat. Quick commercial thoughts before Friday:

1) Offer a capped uplift schedule: +10% at month 6, +15% at month 12, +20% at month 18 (only if utilization triggers exceed forecast thresholds). This gives predictability while keeping upside for BlueWave.
2) Add a one-time onboarding credit (10% of month 1 committed tokens) to help absorb early overages during go-live.
3) For the auto-renew pause, propose a formal "procurement review" clause: if procurement initiates review within 60 days pre-renewal, auto-renew is held and the parties enter a 30-day negotiation window; charges continue at a month-to-month rate until resolution.

I'll bring a sample breakout and invoice language.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Director | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Term architecture proposal & autorenew safeguards

Team —

High level on legal redlines before our call:

- Auto-renew pause: Marissa endorses Karthik's structure but recommends we explicitly limit the number of consecutive pauses to one per renewal cycle (to avoid indefinite delays).
- Price cap language: accept a cap request but we should tie it to CPI + X or to a fixed percentage (I recommend max 12% year-over-year).
- Proration: include worked examples in the SOW and an appendix with the proration formula.

I'll prepare a redline SOW showing authority blocks and the procurement-review clause.

-Marissa
General Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Next steps & SOW (attached) — call summary from today

Sara / Tom / Procurement —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Quick summary and agreed next steps:

Agreements from today's call:
- Initial term: 18 months (aligned to BlueWave launch).
- Renewal options: BlueWave chooses 12-month renewals going forward.
- Ramp: staged buckets at months 1/6/12/18 with uplift caps (+10%/+15%/+20%).
- Auto-renew guardrail: auto-renew will trigger only if usage is within 20% of final-month usage AND no procurement review is initiated within 60 days pre-renewal. If a procurement review is initiated, auto-renew is paused once per renewal cycle for a 30-day negotiation window; monthly billing continues at the prevailing month-to-month rate.
- Onboarding credit: one-time credit equal to 10% of month-1 committed tokens applied to first invoice.
- Co-terming: Redwood will provide a prorated invoice to align future renewals to BlueWave FY (examples in attached workbook).

Action items:
1) Stephanie to send the redline SOW and DocuSign link (attached) — SOW_BlueWave_v2.pdf.
2) BlueWave procurement to review redline and return comments within 5 business days.
3) Camila to share onboarding milestones and initial rollout schedule by 5/16.
4) Karthik to prepare the final invoice examples and amortization for finance.

Link to DocuSign: https://docusign.com/req/abc123
Attached: SOW_BlueWave_v2.pdf, term_matrix_and_ramp.xlsx

If there are no substantive comments from procurement by Fri EOD, I'll send the DocuSign envelope for signature.

Cheers,
Stephanie
